_about: Plain-language What's new cards for the ADMIN page only (admin/news.mjs). The client dashboards read CHANGELOG.md's [client] lines and never this file. One entry per version: summary (one line) and items (type new | improved | fixed, tag client | internal, text). A version missing here falls back to wording made from CHANGELOG.md.

1.44.0.title: Change a passphrase from the Builder
1.44.0.summary: PJ can change a firm's dashboard passphrase from the Builder; the files and GHL links follow safely.

items.text: Changing a firm's passphrase in the Builder re-locks its dashboard details and its report with the new one (checked), updates its GHL menu links, and rolls everything back if a step fails.

1.43.0.title: New clients stand out
1.43.0.summary: Clients added this week have a NEW tag and sit at the top; Reports settings is in your name menu.

items.text: Clients added in the last 7 days have a gold NEW tag and "Added today" (or the date), and sit at the top of the list, newest first.
Your name menu has Reports settings, with how many of the 5 report connections are set up.
While the list loads, the LFMP mark sits in the middle of the screen.

1.42.0.title: Reports on their own
1.42.0.summary: A client can have Reports without a KPI dashboard; every report has an Overview.

items.text: Every report has an Overview, even with one source. Without CallRail it shows no call tiles, only what is linked.
Reports-only clients (no KPI dashboard) build every night with their own passphrase. They are never listed here as KPI firms.

1.41.0.title: BrightLocal trial key protected
1.41.0.summary: The bell says when the team site has paused BrightLocal reads to save the trial key.

items.text: The nightly Reports run asks BrightLocal only 3 times per firm, and every request is counted towards the trial key's 1,000.
An amber notice in the bell when the BrightLocal trial key reaches 800 requests and the team site stops reading BrightLocal (the saved list keeps working).

1.40.0.title: Done moments On / Off
1.40.0.summary: Done moments can be switched off; a client's own CallRail key is supported in Reports.

items.text: Done moments: On / Off. Switch it off in your name menu → Done moments for no popup, sound or voice on any job: you get the usual progress bar and Done popup. The voice greeting has its own switch.
Reports: a client with their own CallRail account is built with their own key (set in the Builder), never LFMP's.

1.39.0.title: LeadPro Reports: calls, Google and ads
1.39.0.summary: Reports can now show calls and website leads (CallRail), Google Search, website traffic, Google Business Profile and Google Ads.

items.text: The nightly Reports build reads CallRail, Search Console, GA4, Google Business Profile and Google Ads for every client that has them linked in the Builder. Counts only: no names, numbers or recordings. Each source starts once PJ adds its key.
New tabs stay a Draft until the team presses Publish new tabs after Andy's review; clients keep seeing only the tabs already approved.
A broken source (for example GA4 with no access) shows in the bell and the Slack DM once, with what to do about it.

1.38.0.title: Done moments
1.38.0.summary: Setting up a new firm now runs in a popup that ends with a finish animation, a sound and a voice line.

items.text: New firm runs in a popup that follows the real steps; hide it and keep working. When it's done you hear your sound and voice line. Your name menu → Done moments has the settings; Classic keeps things as they were.

1.37.0.title: LeadPro Reports (pilot)
1.37.0.summary: A Reports page per client with their Google rankings from BrightLocal, built every night.

items.text: LeadPro Reports, Phase 1: a client set up in the Builder's Reports tab gets a Reports page (Rankings from BrightLocal), rebuilt every night at 2:00 AM ET and unlocked with the same passphrase as its KPI dashboard. It stays a Draft until Add to GHL menu, after Andy's review.
A failed Reports build shows in the bell and in the Slack DM, like a failed sync.

1.36.0.title: Menu position in GHL
1.36.0.summary: Pick where "KPI Dashboard" sits in a client's GHL menu and copy the exact CSS to paste.

items.text: Setup → GHL menu link → Menu position in GHL: pick the number, copy the lines, open GHL's Custom CSS, paste and Save there, then press I've pasted it. The bell reminds you until then.

1.35.0.title: How the mapping is filled in
1.35.0.summary: Both mapping screens explain how each stage was filled in, and a guessed stage says which word it matched.

items.text: Map pipelines and Edit mapping have "How we fill this in for you": what was kept, what was guessed and from which words, and what's left for you. It opens the first time, then stays the way you leave it on this device.
A guessed stage says which word it matched, for example Guessed: “Deposit”. Edit mapping for law firms says whether you're looking at the saved mapping, the LFMP template or a guess.

1.34.0.title: The real WPP logo
1.34.0.summary: WPP dashboards show the real Web Promotion Partners logo, in colour.

items.text: WPP dashboards show the real Web Promotion Partners logo in full colour (in dark mode only "WEB" turns white). LFMP dashboards don't change.

1.33.0.title: LFMP or WPP, everywhere
1.33.0.summary: Filter Scorecards by LFMP or WPP; WPP dashboards show the WPP logo.

items.text: "All clients ▾" next to the search shows only LFMP or only WPP firms. The same choice applies on Clients, Scorecards and Reviews on this device. On a phone, the status and brand filters are one Filter button.
A WPP firm's dashboard shows the Web Promotion Partners logo and name (header, footer and the Draft banner) after its next sync. LFMP dashboards look exactly as before.

1.32.1.title: Add to GHL menu says why
1.32.1.summary: If GHL won't add the KPI link, the message gives GHL's own reason.

items.text: When Add to GHL menu doesn't work, the message now says what GHL answered (for example that it refused the link and why) instead of only "GitHub stopped it before it finished".

1.32.0.title: Ask first, and Remove firm
1.32.0.summary: Changes ask first; Remove firm works like Remove scorecard in the Builder.

items.text: New firm, Save mapping, Re-read GHL and Show CSS rule now ask first, saying what will happen and what won't. Cancel does nothing.
Remove firm (was Delete firm) is the same as Remove scorecard in the Builder: it also takes its KPI link out of the GHL menu, and it's logged in the bell.

1.31.0.title: A clear Done for every long job
1.31.0.summary: A small cyclist while it works, then a popup with what changed (or what went wrong).

items.text: While Re-read GHL, Save mapping, Sync now, Add to GHL menu or New firm runs, you see plain words and a gold bar with a small cyclist.
When it finishes, a popup says Done and what changed, or why it didn't work and whether anything changed, with Try again.
Finished while you were away? The popup waits for you, and every result is in the bell under Recent jobs.

1.30.0.title: KPI links open inside GHL, with their menu CSS rule
1.30.0.summary: And renaming a pipeline in GHL no longer drops a scorecard to 0 leads.

items.text: Add to GHL menu now makes the KPI Dashboard link open inside GHL, as in our setup steps.
Setup → GHL menu link shows the Custom CSS rule that puts the link in its place in the menu, with Copy. For older links, Show CSS rule reads it from GHL (read only).
Law-firm scorecards now remember their pipelines by GHL's ID, so renaming a pipeline in GHL keeps the numbers counting.
If a counted pipeline disappears from GHL, the bell and Slack say "Pipeline not found" with a link to Edit mapping, and the dashboard keeps its last numbers instead of showing 0.

1.29.2.title: The greeting's three numbers show at once
1.29.2.summary: The team site keeps them ready, so they don't wait on the other tools.

items.text: The greeting's three numbers now show at once, also on the first sign-in of the day. The team site keeps them ready (updated every 10 minutes).

1.29.1.title: The greeting plays again after you sign out and back in
1.29.1.summary: And it always shows all three numbers.

items.text: The greeting plays again after you sign out and back in, and always shows all three numbers.

1.29.0.title: A greeting when you sign in, once a day, with what needs you
1.29.0.summary: Your name, theme and Sign out are now under your initials.

items.text: A greeting when you sign in, once a day, with what needs you: reviews that need you, scorecards that need attention and clients in progress. Click, tap or press any key to skip it.
Your name, theme and Sign out are now under your initials. Click your initials (on the phone too) to open the menu.

1.28.0.title: Scorecards for medical and dental practices
1.28.0.summary: Pick a practice type, map each pipeline stage once, and new scorecards start as a Draft.

items.text: Practice type for every firm: Law firm (unchanged), Medical & dental, or Other. Medical scorecards show patient enquiries, consults booked, show rate, treatment accepted, procedures completed and value.
Map pipelines: choose what each GHL stage means (enquiry, contacted, consult booked, attended, yes, done, lost or ignore) as chips. It's pre-filled; renaming a stage in GHL doesn't break it.
Each person counts once, even when they're in several pipelines. Counts only (on for medical) keeps patient names out of the scorecard.
The bell (and Slack) tells you when GHL has a stage that isn't mapped yet, or when a scorecard was removed.
New scorecards start as a Draft. "Add to GHL menu" puts the KPI link in the client's GHL menu after Andy's review.

1.27.0.title: Every click shows it's working
1.27.0.summary: The button you press fills with gold while it works, then says what it did.

items.text: The button you press fills with gold from left to right and says what it's doing ("Syncing…", "Saving…", "Deleting…"), then "✓" when it's done. Other buttons next to it wait, so nothing is sent twice.
A thin gold line under the top bar shows while anything is loading.
Every button, row and tab dips slightly the moment you press it. If something fails, you see the error; nothing finishes silently.
A firm's name, close button and tabs stay at the top while you scroll its details.
The line under Scorecards uses the same words and count as the "Needs attention" filter, e.g. "4 firms · 2 need attention".

1.26.0.title: Firms A to Z
1.26.0.summary: The firm list is in A to Z order, and the leads trend only shows when it is fair.

items.text: Firms are listed A to Z by the name you see, in every filter and in search results, on a computer and on a phone. "The" at the start is skipped, so The Mahdavi Law Firm is under M. The status dots and the Needs attention count still show what is urgent.

The leads trend (▲ / ▼ against the 90 days before) only shows once the firm has a full 90 days before on its scorecard. Until then the row just says "leads · 90 days", so you never see a big jump that only means the scorecard is new.
A firm that hasn't synced for a while now reads "No successful sync for 3 h" (it read "No successful sync in 3 hours 2 h ago").

1.25.1.title: Small fix on phones
1.25.1.summary: On a phone, "No leads yet" is small text again.

items.text: On a phone, "No leads yet" showed in the big number font; it is small text again.

1.25.0.title: Numbers with meaning
1.25.0.summary: Leads trend, "No leads yet" and one colour per meaning.

items.text: Under each firm's leads you now see the trend against the 90 days before: ▲ green, ▼ red, — same.
A firm with no leads in 90 days shows "No leads yet" instead of a bold 0.
Red always means an alert (numbers stopped updating) and amber a notice, in the bell, the firm list and the Needs attention filter.
Pop-ups, buttons and boxes are rounded and in normal sentence case, like the list; each firm has one name in all three tools.

1.24.0.summary: Smoother loading and firm details, the same in all three tools.

items.text: While the firm list loads you see the LFMP blocks and "Loading scorecards…", then the list fades in. After 20 seconds without an answer you get Try again.
Firm details slide in from the right and the list dims behind them; ✕, Esc, a click on the dim or ‹ Scorecards slides them away. While details are open, click the dim to get back to the list.
If your device is set to reduce motion, nothing moves.

1.23.0.summary: A new, simpler look, the same in the Builder, Scorecards and Reviews.

items.text: One top bar for all three tools; on a phone, tabs at the bottom (Clients, Scorecards, Reviews, Me) and the gold + for a new firm.
Theme, Show test clients, Refresh, Team sign-ins, What's new, Install the app and Sign out are all under your initials (Me).
The sync times and the token keeper are at the top of the bell. The repo link is at the foot of What's new.
One calm list of firms: status, leads in the last 90 days, and the whole row opens the firm's details.

1.22.0.summary: Sync problems now also reach PJ as a Slack message.

items.text: When the bell gets a new sync issue, PJ gets one Slack message about it, and one more when it clears. Same issues as the bell, never repeated while still open. "Holding previous numbers" stays a bell notice only.
If a KPI dashboard set up from the Builder fails or stops, PJ gets a Slack message with the firm and the step, and a link to Retry in the Builder.

1.21.0.summary: Steadier syncs: no more out-of-memory failures, fewer false "chain stopped" alerts.

items.text: LFMP's sync no longer fails now and then on its large email history. The numbers on the dashboards are exactly the same.
The bell no longer says the sync chain stopped while GitHub is just slow to start a sync (it still does after 2 hours).

1.20.0.summary: Sign out next to your name, your last sign-in, and who on the team signed in.

items.text: A Sign out button sits next to your name (on a phone, in the ⋯ menu). It signs you out of all three tools and says "See you next shift."
Under your name: when you last signed in.
⋯ → Team sign-ins lists everyone who signed in in the last 90 days, with their last sign-in and how often in 30 days.

1.19.0.summary: Google sign-in only: no admin password, no GitHub token to paste.

items.text: Your Google sign-in is all you need. The admin password and the GitHub token screen are gone; the top bar shows your name and Sign out.
Remember a dashboard passphrase for the whole team: anyone signed in opens the names in Details without typing it. New firms are remembered automatically, and Forget it removes one.

1.18.0.summary: The KPI admin now opens only on the team site, behind Google sign-in.

items.text: The KPI admin now opens only at lfmp-admin.pages.dev, after Google sign-in. The old address shows a Moved page with a button to the new site.

1.17.0.summary: The KPI admin is getting a team-only address with Google sign-in.

items.text: The KPI admin can now run from the team's own site behind Google sign-in (lfmp-admin.pages.dev). Client contact details still come from the dashboards, which stay public for clients.

1.16.0.summary: The KPI admin moved to dashboard.lawfirmmarketingpros.com. Old links still work.

items.text: The KPI admin now lives at dashboard.lawfirmmarketingpros.com, behind Google sign-in. Old peejayedz.github.io links forward to the new address.
Open dashboard, Copy GHL link and new firms use the new address. Menu links already in GHL keep working and were not changed.

1.15.0.summary: The old KPI admin password is gone: sign in with the shared admin password.

items.text: The KPI admin now signs in only with the shared admin password (the same as the Builder and Review). The old admin-only password and its screen were removed.
If 30 minutes pass without activity, the next click locks straight away.

1.14.0.summary: One login for the KPI admin, the Builder and Review, and a red colour so you know you're in the scorecards.

items.text: One admin password opens the KPI admin, the Builder and the Review admin. Sign in once and move between them from the top menu without being asked again.
The KPI admin has its own colour: a red band, a KPI chip and a red headline. Main buttons stay gold.
Problems always show an icon and words (✕ Sync failed, ! Needs attention), so red never means a problem on its own.
Clients and Review open in the same window. Lock on any tool locks all three.
After 5 wrong passwords in a row, sign-in pauses for 2 minutes with a countdown.
Lock now also stops a running sync check and closes open panels.

1.13.1.summary: See exactly who isn't in a pipeline, remember a firm's passphrase, and find the GHL menu link under Setup.

items.text: Contacts not in a pipeline show name, email, phone, how they came in (form, chat, booking, call, text or email) and the date, each with Open in GHL. No name? The email or phone shows instead of "Unknown".
"Open Contacts in GHL" is now a button at the top of the needs-attention box.
"Remember on this computer" next to Unlock keeps the firm's passphrase locked with your admin password, so the names show straight away next time. Lock or Forget token clears it.
"Copy GHL link" is now "Copy GHL menu link" and lives in the Setup tab. Overview keeps Open dashboard, Re-sync and Edit mapping.
"Copied" shows only next to the button you clicked, and goes away after a few seconds.

1.13.0.summary: A simpler firm list, a Details panel for everything else, and no more logging in again when you go back.

items.text: The firm list shows only what you need to decide: status, leads in 90 days, Dashboard and Details. A firm that needs attention says why, as a link.

Details panel with Overview (what needs attention and how to fix it, actions, info), Performance (7 / 30 / 90 days, the same numbers as the client dashboard) and Setup (mapping, connection, banner, delete).
"Lead not in a pipeline" lists who it is, with Open in GHL, when this browser has the firm's dashboard passphrase (or you type it).
Test firms are hidden unless you tick "Show test firms".
Going back to the firm list, or using the browser's Back button, no longer asks for the password. Lock, closing the tab or 30 minutes idle still lock the page.

1.12.0.summary: The admin page has the new LFMP look, and New firm can use the LeadPro app instead of a pasted token.

items.text: New firm → "Use the LeadPro app" (recommended): no token to create or paste. It makes and saves the dashboard passphrase, starts the same setup the Sub-account Builder uses, and shows each step. Retry only finishes what's missing.
Firm list: a summary strip, filters (Needs attention, App, Private Integration, Tests) and search by name, slug or GHL name.
New look: dark and light themes, the gold LFMP style and the same top bar as the builder. Auto · Light · Dark keeps your choice.
Edit mapping shows each stage as a short chip, with Save mapping at the top.
What's new is now this side panel, with plain summaries and the technical notes one click away.

1.11.2.summary: A sync started while another one was running could fail to save. Fixed.

items.text: A Re-sync or a new firm's first sync that had to wait for another sync no longer fails at the save step.

1.11.1.summary: New firms from the builder could stop while reading GHL. Fixed.

items.text: A new firm from the Sub-account Builder no longer stops at "Read the sub-account's pipelines and stages".

1.11.0.summary: The Sub-account Builder can set up a KPI dashboard by itself.

items.text: New firms from the Sub-account Builder: no token to paste. It never adds two firms for one sub-account.
Stage-mapping presets: firms made from the LFMP template snapshots get their stages mapped automatically.
The "KPI Dashboard" menu link can be added to the firm's GHL sub-account automatically.
When the stages had to be guessed, the bell shows "Review mapping" until Edit mapping is saved.

1.10.0.summary: Firms can get their GHL token from the LeadPro Connector app, refreshed every hour.

items.text: Token keeper: firms set up through the app get a fresh GHL token every hour. Private Integration firms are never touched.
The bell warns when the token keeper hasn't run, the app needs reconnecting or isn't on a sub-account.
Each firm shows Token: App or Token: Private Integration.

1.9.0.summary: Simpler funnel for firms that sign on the first call; renaming a stage in GHL can't break a mapping.

items.text: Funnel simplified for firms that sign on the first call.
Stages can be saved by their GHL id, so renaming a stage in GHL keeps the mapping working.
Funnel steps can be hidden per firm (Mahdavi hides the consult steps).

1.8.0.summary: The LeadPro logo is on the dashboards.

items.text: LeadPro logo added; date line tidied.

1.7.1.summary: More detail on how contacts outside a pipeline came in.

items.text: Each sync records how new contacts outside a pipeline came in (form, chat, booking, call, text, email). Counts only.

1.7.0.summary: Dashboards say which pipeline New leads counts, and the admin page flags contacts outside a pipeline.

items.text: Under New leads: which pipeline it counts, and why someone never added to it isn't counted.
Hover explanations open with a tap on phones, tablets and inside GoHighLevel.
Firm list and bell: new contacts in the last 30 days that aren't in any pipeline.

1.6.1.summary: A read-only check for missing leads.

items.text: "Diagnose missing leads" workflow: counts only, changes nothing.

1.6.0.summary: The bell: sync problems listed with what to do.

items.text: Bell with a count of new sync issues, each with what happened, numbered steps and fix buttons.
Update token checks all 9 scopes before replacing a firm's token.
Firm rows show OK, Held or Failed and the GHL sub-account name.
The "may be incomplete" note clears when the counts recover, or after 24 hours.
Sync chain: each sync starts the next one, because GitHub skips many scheduled runs.
Firm list shows the last update time and warns when it's over 2 hours old.

1.4.0.summary: Call and message numbers no longer dip between updates.

items.text: Missed calls, speed to first contact and contact rate no longer dip when GHL returns only part of the history.
Each channel is pulled two or three times and combined; a short pull holds the previous numbers for up to 3 syncs.

1.3.1.summary: A read-only check of GHL's message export.

items.text: "Diagnose message export" workflow: counts and timings only.

1.3.0.summary: No-shows count as booked consults that were missed.

items.text: A lead in a no-show stage now counts under Consult booked and No-shows.
New firm pre-selects every pipeline with 3 or more funnel stages.
Saving an unchanged mapping leaves config.json exactly as it was.

1.2.0.summary: What's new on the dashboards and the admin page.

items.text: "How this works" has a What's new section; the footer shows the version.
The admin page shows the full changelog.

1.1.0.summary: Shared settings live in one place.

items.text: Targets, banner and other shared settings are set once for all firms; each firm keeps only its own values.

1.0.0.summary: One repo and one admin page for every firm.

items.text: Every firm's scorecard has its own address and shows its practice area.
Refresh data is now Reload; dashboards update from GoHighLevel every 30 minutes.
Admin page: password lock, firm list, New firm with stage mapping, retry and clean-up.
Single-firm syncs no longer lose data.
